assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on PSV-4110 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4110 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4110 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-4110 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 16 June 2022 an incident occurred on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
